name: MEV bot 0x05f0 unprotected swap entry point
summary: The unverified MEV contract exposed swap entry point 0xf6ebebbb with no caller check: any caller could swap the contract's own balances through a pool and minimum output of its choice, including zero. A flash-loan-funded attacker skewed Curve tricrypto, had the contract dump its USDC, USDT, WBTC and WETH into the skewed pools and unwound; a searcher repeated it a block later.
notes: Non-upgradeable contract, unchanged from deployment. Its per-token output-receiver mapping was cleared at block 18416187, but a replay of the anchor with the old receivers restored still drained the contract at skewed prices, so that change is not a reset.

Searcher 0xc0ffeebabe repeated the call in the next block, taking 6.24 WBTC net from the contract and keeping the profit, so it is a copycat. Every earlier token flow of the contract is the operator's own trading; the operator swept the remainder at block 18523406.
